<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check player position
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'O':
        player_boundary = n['boundary']
        print(f"Player boundary: {player_boundary}")
        break

# Find white pixels near the player
white_pixels = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] == 1]
print(f"\nWhite pixels near player (within 5 cols):")
for n in white_pixels:
    r, c = n['boundary'][0]
    if 30 <= r <= 42 and 50 <= c <= 62:
        print(f"  ({r}, {c})")

# Click on white pixel at [35, 54] which is near player

white_pixels2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] == 1]
print(f"White pixels after: {len(white_pixels2)}")

# Check if the target white pixel is still there
target_still = any(n['boundary'][0] == [35, 54] for n in white_pixels2)
print(f"Target at (35, 54) still there: {target_still}")

# Check nearby white pixels
print("\nWhite pixels near player after:")
for n in white_pixels2:
    r, c = n['boundary'][0]
    if 30 <= r <= 42 and 50 <= c <= 62:
        print(f"  ({r}, {c})")
